content: Apple had a record-breaking quarter for iPhone sales — despite not releasing a standard model during its latest refresh. In its fourth-quarter earnings report released on Monday, Apple says it earned $57.58 billion in iPhone revenue, a 17 percent jump from the same time last year. The increase in revenue follows the launch of Apple’s iPhone 18 lineup in September, which included a pricier iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max model. The company raised prices across its older models at the same time. Apple also took the wraps off its first folding phone, the iPhone Duo, but its preorder sales aren’t included in this earnings report. Like other device-makers, Apple has been dealing with supply chain constraints and rising memory costs, leading it to raise prices across its products. Meanwhile, Apple only had a “limited” number of iPhone Duos available in store at launch, with some estimated shipment dates extending into 2027. “We saw higher memory costs as compared to the June quarter, and that was partly offset by the benefit of carrying inventory and lower costs on non-memory components,” Apple CEO John Ternus said during an interview with CNBC. Apple reported a 12 percent increase in revenue overall, ballooning to $114.5 billion. Its Mac business grew 24 percent to $10.79 billion, while Apple’s services division, which includes App Store commissions along with subscriptions to services like Apple TV and Apple Music, grew to $31.57 billion. iPad revenue declined 10 percent year over year, with $6.23 billion in sales. Apple shook up other areas of its product lineup with some other major launches over the past several weeks. It made a big push into the smart home space with its first smart home display and a series of video doorbells, security cameras, and door locks, made in collaboration with LG and Schneider Electric. Last week, Apple also revealed a MacBook Pro with a touchscreen — a design choice that its executives famously resisted.
chineseTitle: 即使没有新标准 iPhone，苹果仍创造了 iPhone 销售记录

chineseContent: 尽管苹果在最新的更新中没有发布标准型号，但 iPhone 的季度销量还是打破了纪录。苹果在周一发布的第四季度财报中表示，iPhone 收入为 575.8 亿美元，比去年同期增长 17%。收入增长是在苹果 9 月份推出 iPhone 18 系列之后实现的，其中包括价格更高的 iPhone 18 Pro 和 Pro Max 型号。该公司同时提高了旧型号的价格。苹果还揭开了首款折叠手机 iPhone Duo 的面纱，但其预购销量并未包含在本财报中。与其他设备制造商一样，苹果一直在应对供应链限制和内存成本上涨的问题，导致其提高了产品价格。与此同时，苹果在发布时仅提供“有限”数量的 iPhone Duo，部分预计发货日期将延长至 2027 年。苹果首席执行官 John Ternus 在接受 CNBC 采访时表示：“与 6 月份季度相比，我们发现内存成本更高，但库存成本和非内存组件成本降低的好处部分抵消了这一成本。” Apple 公布的总体收入增长了 12%，达到 1,145 亿美元。其 Mac 业务增长了 24%，达到 107.9 亿美元，而苹果的服务部门（包括 App Store 佣金以及 Apple TV 和 Apple Music 等服务的订阅）增长到 315.7 亿美元。 iPad 收入同比下降 10%，销售额为 62.3 亿美元。过去几周，苹果公司推出了其他一些重大产品，震撼了其产品线的其他领域。该公司凭借首款智能家居显示器以及一系列合作制造的视频门铃、安全摄像头和门锁，大力进军智能家居领域。
